text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —It was the day before Valentine's Day.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
When I told my Trainer I'd give them chocolate,
they just said, "It's the thought that counts~."
Even though I want to put that thought into shape!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Totally~.
Let's just force it on them anyway!
Btw, mine's handmade!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(...Chocolate is the devil's food.
Fawning over something like that is... ridiculous.)

text_block_list.name: Excited Child
text_block_list.text:
Mom, if I make the chocolate really well,
do you think Daddy will be happy?

text_block_list.name: Child's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Of course. Let's make sure to tell him 'thank you for everything'.
Well... even if it doesn't turn out great,
Papa will probably cry tears of joy anyway... hehe.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...Sigh.
Everywhere I go, this is all anyone talks about."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...
...Feelings of gratitude, huh.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(...The contract is still ongoing.
There's no deadline anymore, either.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"I question whether there's really a need
to go out of my way to tell them, though..."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
......
...Is this... proper etiquette?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(...First of all,
I should definitely avoid heart-shaped ones.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (Something too expensive won't do either. It might feel like too much of a burden.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(...Would more be better?
Then again, a smaller portion feels more elegant...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (Still, having such a big box brings its own problems...)

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Welcome!
Having trouble deciding?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...No, not really.

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
If you want, I can give you some advice!
Is it for a lover? Or maybe a crush?
Oh, I've also got some great recommendations for friendship chocolates~

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...It's nothing like that.

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text: So it's for your family, then. In that case, how about this one? It comes in a tin with a puppy design...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
…………
...I'd like to think about it on my own.

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text: Ah, valued customer... P-Please come again~!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh*

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: "...We shouldn't be wasting time on something like this."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Forget it... Let's go home.
Not like anyone's expecting anything from me anyway.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —The day of Valentine's.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
......
...Could this be...
choice_data_list: It looked so good, I just had to buy it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As I strolled around town,
everywhere was entirely painted in Valentine's colors.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I thought you might accept something modest like this,
so I bought it to reward you for your daily hard work, but...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...
...To think there was a way like this...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: It's unpleasant.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...I don't consider this a defeat.
Next time, I'll definitely show them what I'm made of.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...It looks quite hot,
so I shall let it cool down a bit before eating."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She looked kind of moody, or maybe not.
At any rate, it seemed like she'd enjoy drinking the hot chocolate.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: But...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (...If it were from that dog food can earlier, it might not have been... that bad.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —The day of Valentine's.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Here, chocolates.
They looked delicious, so I bought some.
choice_data_list: Oh, come to think of it...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today was Valentine's Day.
With how busy everyday life had been, I'd almost forgotten, but...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
There's plenty here, so I'll leave them right here.
Please help yourself.
choice_data_list: Ah, thank you, I'll dig in.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
choice_data_list: Delicious... It's soaking right into my tired body...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...
...Is that so.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I let out a sigh of relief at the sweetness of the chocolate.
At that moment, for just an instant, it looked as though Admire Groove
smiled—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: What is it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her usual dignified expression.
...Was it just my imagination?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Lost in thought, I reach out for another piece
and pop a chocolate into my mouth.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Eating too much isn't good for you.
Please be mindful of how much you eat in one sitting, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With a simple "yes" to those words—spoken without a hint of harshness, like a natural slip of the tongue—we basked in that sweetness for a little while.
